productionStatement: No SQL, docker exec, deploy, stop or restart against any hawa-production-* resource. attempts.finding: restate_nightly.py read GET /v1/ingress/status without the operator bearer; Core answered 401, so every --plan/--apply and watchdog --recover would be refused in production. Fixed (ADR-134) with CoreSwitchWireTest.

drill defects: the one-off blob-verify container needed the restored Restate volume to exist before compose ran; its error text carried the throwaway owner URL (drill now passes it through the environment, scrubs receipts, and the log was deleted); the pause-update check assumed getUpdates returns only after release.
--restore-into refused because another session's hawa-chaos stack was running a Restate with the same node name (hawa-restate-chaos-1). The drill now uses its own node name, hawa-restate-r10-1.

two check defects, no product defect: the ChatInbox count included its setMode handler, and the pause-update check required the hand-on after the release while the poller's 5 s switch cache handed it to a restarted Restate 10 s before the release. Timer timestamps are now read with SELECT *.

findings: BUG (fixed, ADR-134): the Core switch status read had no bearer; enabling the flag before this fix fails every night.
The nightly pause is dominated by the Restate health-check interval (10 s); Restate itself restarts in about a second.

A running invocation at 03:30 holds intake paused for the whole drain (default 300 s) before the capture proceeds anyway (runningInvocationsAtStop is recorded; the invocation resumed correctly after the restore).

The worker poller reads the kill switch at most every 5 s: an update can be handed on in the first seconds of a pause or up to 5 s after the release. The offset moves only after Restate accepts an update, so nothing is lost; Telegram keeps unconfirmed updates about 24 h.

Recovery point: work after the last paired night is not restored; updates confirmed after the backup are not offered again by Telegram (lost, requester must resend); a send marked after the dump but journaled before the capture may repeat. Dump-to-capture gap measured 14 s (quiet) and 44 s (with a drain).
The monthly design.hawa.restore-drill launch agent is not installed on the office Mac (only watchdog, nightly and weekly schema drill are).
Production archive destination is an iCloud Drive folder; the Restate volume is 4.7 MB, so the added archive is a few MB per night.
